name: La Granja de la Costera (Spain)
description: Yellow field with four red bends from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with a white village with a church tower.
history: Municipal flag of La Granja de la Costera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: four bends from the upper hoist to the lower fly
village of houses with a church tower
